beta.notes:
New in this version:
• When a Pathways upload does not reach PCA Extension, Work Sample Buddy now gives clear Chrome setup steps, can open the Chrome Web Store, and lets you copy support details.

Fixes:
• Fixed upload recovery suggesting an update when Chrome was connected to another installed copy of Work Sample Buddy. The message now identifies the bridge that Chrome is using.
• The Chrome bridge now identifies its completed-work-date capability and always returns date status for finalized students, so an unreadable date record gives useful guidance instead of a misleading update prompt.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• Missing Schoology work now offers a direct assignment link and a Reload action in the center of the viewer.
• Reload checks Schoology again and downloads newly submitted work automatically.

Fixes:
• Fixed course-card clicks opening a different student's course or assignment. The selected student and course now stay together through grading.
• Fixed missing-assignment links sending signed-in teachers to the generic Schoology login page.
